videoDetails.title: Never Trust An LLM
videoDetails.shortDescription:
LLMs hallucinate constantly - they lie about facts, invent entities, and ignore context. Learn why this happens, how it works, and how to protect yourself from AI misinformation.

1:33 Factual Errors
3:22 Fabricated Entities
4:04 Contextual Inconsistency

7:08 Why Do They Guess?
10:01 How To Fix It
